tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: The page.

tokens.name: color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: A block set into the page: a code block, a word of code in a sentence, the place of a picture that is not there or failed to load.

tokens.name: color-surface-footer
tokens.usage: The band of the footer, across the window under every page of both sites. What is drawn on it keeps the dark theme's colors in either theme, so the band is the dark theme's page under a light page, and a step lighter than it under a dark one, where a black a step darker would look like a mistake rather than a band.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: Text, and a link's own color.

tokens.name: color-ink-muted
tokens.usage: What stands beside the text: dates, years, a caption, a link card's description, the words around a search's match. Also a quote, which is someone else's text, and a field's edge and placeholder, which have to be seen.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Rules between parts of a page and the edge of a card. Decoration: nothing is told by it alone.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The one color: the underline of a link, the edge of a link card under the pointer, small marks. Not for text on the light surface, where it is too pale to read.

tokens.name: color-accent-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as text: a link under the pointer.

tokens.name: color-mark
tokens.usage: Behind the words a search found, with the ink on it.

families.sans: "Inter", "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "BIZ UDPGothic", "Yu Gothic", sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for Latin letters and numerals, Noto Sans JP for Japanese. The system's gothic stands in while a font is on its way.

styles.name: text-title
styles.sample: 開発のストーリー分割・タスク分割をするときに考えていること
styles.usage: The title of a page: a post's, on its own page.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.sample: タスクの大きさ・小さくする考え方
styles.usage: A heading inside a post. On the portfolio: the person's name in the profile column, the name at the head of the footer of either site, a section's heading, the title of the newest talk, a talk's day in a list of talks, and the name of a company on the career page.

styles.name: text-subheading
styles.sample: 4 月から突然プロダクトマネージャーを務めることになった
styles.usage: A heading under a heading inside a post, and on the portfolio the name of a project, of a company in a short list and of a role.

styles.name: text-minor-heading
styles.sample: 仕事では、責任範囲が一気に広がった一年だった
styles.usage: The least heading inside a post: a line of body text with the weight of a heading.

styles.name: text-entry
styles.sample: ポストモーテムを意味のあるものにするには？
styles.usage: A title that links somewhere: a post in a list of posts, a page in a link card, what a search found, a talk in a list of talks.

styles.name: text-lead
styles.sample: 東京のワンキャリアで、エンジニア・デザイナー・プロダクトマネージャーあわせて約50名、12チームのプロダクト組織を率いています。
styles.usage: The introduction that opens the portfolio's top page and its about page: one paragraph a step larger than the text, on the tall line of Japanese.

styles.name: text-lead-latin
styles.sample: I lead a product organization of about 50 engineers, designers and product managers across 12 teams at ONE CAREER Inc. in Tokyo.
styles.usage: text-lead on a page in English (lang="en"). Latin letters need less space between lines than Japanese.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: たまたまかもですが 1on1 で二人連続でこんな話になったので。
styles.usage: The text of a post, and what a reader types into a field. The tall line is for Japanese.

styles.name: text-body-latin
styles.sample: I started out as a Ruby on Rails engineer, moved into engineering management, and now spend most of my time on product strategy and company-wide decisions.
styles.usage: text-body on a page in English (lang="en"): the text of the portfolio's about page and of a role on its career page. Latin letters need less space between lines than Japanese.

styles.name: text-small
styles.sample: プライバシーポリシー
styles.usage: Navigation, the footer, a link card's description and site, the caption of an image, the line that says how a search went and the words around its match, a project's description and the event of a talk.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: The line under the site's name.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Numerals that head something: a year over its posts, a post's date on its own page, the year over a talk's day. Its figures are tabular, so that dates line up under each other. The one place it is set in words is the name of a group of links in the footer.

styles.name: text-figure
styles.usage: Numerals beside what they belong to: a post's day before its title in the index, the date of what a search found, an article's date under its title, a project's years, a company's or a role's period. Tabular, so that a column of them lines up.

styles.name: text-site
styles.usage: The site's name in the header.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The reader's own monospace font; nothing is downloaded for code.

styles.name: text-code
styles.usage: Code: a block of it, and a word of it inside a sentence.

spacing.note: A 4px base in rem, so that spacing grows with the reader's font size. The `width-` ones are widths of the layout.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between the lines of a link card; between an element and the outline of its focus; between a search result's title and the words under it; between a name and the line under it, and between the lines of a project, a talk or an article.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a date and the title under it; between the items of a list; between an image and its caption; above and below the words in a field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between two posts of one year in the index; between a group's name and its links in the footer; between a heading and the text of a section of the about page.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside a link card and a code block; between a heading and what follows it; between a figure and its title in an index; between a quote and the rule beside it, and between its paragraphs; beside the words in a field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; between the links of a row; under the header's content; above the copyright in the footer, between it and the rule; between a search's field, the line under it and what it found, and between two results; between a section's heading and what it shows, and between two projects or two articles.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above and below a group in an index; above and below a link card; above the least heading inside a post; between the parts of the profile column, between two talks and between two roles at a company.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a label and its rows in an index; above a heading under a heading inside a post; between the blocks of a page of the portfolio, and between two rows of projects.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above the header's content; above the content of a page of text and of a page of the portfolio; under a page's title; between the groups of links in the footer.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Above a heading inside a post; above the footer's links, and between them and the copyright; between the portfolio's profile column and its content; between the years of writing, the companies of a career and the sections of the about page.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Under the content of a page; between the sections of the portfolio's top page.

tokens.name: width-gutter
tokens.usage: The least space between a page's content and the edge of the window.

tokens.name: width-measure
tokens.usage: The width of a column of text: about 42 Japanese characters of body text.

tokens.name: width-aside
tokens.usage: The portfolio's profile column, beside the content of every page. With space-14 between them and a column of width-measure, the two fill width-page.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: The width of the header, of the footer's content and of the index, and of the portfolio's profile column and content together.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: A link card, a code block, a word of code, a field, a picture. The only rounding.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, the edges of cards, and the edge of a field.

tokens.name: stroke-underline
tokens.usage: The underline of a link, the outline of whatever has the keyboard's focus, the rule beside a quote, and the line beside a role that has not ended.
